acceptance: `evolve cycle models --cycle N` on a fixture llm-calls.ndjson prints the tier, selector and serving model for each phase (red: unknown subcommand)
A launch through a fake driver that reports a model records it on the llm-calls line
Records without a serving model print 'unreported'
fix: When a launch completes, record the serving model on its llm-calls record, read from the same reply field `doctor live --model` reads. Add `evolve cycle models --cycle N [--json]`, which prints, per phase and attempt, the requested tier, the dispatched selector and the serving model ('unreported' when the driver does not expose it). It is read-only; a cycle with no records exits 1. Document it in runtime-reference.md's operator commands.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: `evolve models performance` shows the dispatched selector for each attempt from llm-calls.ndjson (cmd_models_performance.go:91-107), not the model that served it. A claude alias or a within-tier model failover can serve a different model than the tier names, and the dossier records the tier (inbox model-failover-provenance-followups). To learn what ran a phase, the operator opens the CLI transcripts and reads message.model.
title: Which model actually served each phase of a cycle is read from CLI transcripts by hand; add `evolve cycle models --cycle N`
